tooltip: Sensor Mode – Selects Standard or HDR sensor operation.
content1: Selects the sensor operating mode: Standard (normal) mode or HDR (High Dynamic Range) mode for scenes with high contrast.

tooltip: Camera Mode – Selects Master (free-running) or Trigger mode.
content1: Selects Master mode, where the camera streams continuously, or Trigger mode, where frames are captured on an external trigger.

tooltip: Special Effects – Selects Normal colour or GrayScale output.
content1: Selects the colour processing applied to the output image: Normal (colour) or GrayScale.

tooltip: Flip Control – Flips the image horizontally and/or vertically.
content1: Mirrors the image horizontally, flips it vertically, or both. The Horizontal and Vertical check boxes are combined into a single orientation value.
setAPIDes: Sets horizontal and vertical flip; the SDK maps the two flags to a FlipModeCU22 value.

tooltip: ROI Auto-Exposure – Selects the region used for auto exposure metering.
content1: Selects Centered (full-frame centred window) or Manual ROI for auto exposure. In Manual mode the ROI position is mapped to 0-255 against the video frame size, and the window size is chosen from 1 to 8.
getAPIDes: Reads the ROI mode, mapped X/Y position and window size.
setAPIDes: Sets the ROI mode; position and window size apply in Manual mode only.

tooltip: Color Kill – Adjusts the colour-kill value.
content1: Sets the colour-kill value, from 0 to 5.

tooltip: Image Capture – Sets the still capture burst length.
content1: Selects the number of frames (1 through 5) captured in a single still-capture burst.

tooltip: Denoise – Enables or disables noise reduction.
content1: Enables or disables the camera's noise reduction (denoise) processing.

tooltip: Lens Correction Mode – Selects the lens shading correction profile.
content1: Selects the lens shading correction (LSC) profile that matches the lighting: Warm White, Bright White, or Daylight.

tooltip: Anti-Flicker Mode – Configures automatic or 50 Hz / 60 Hz flicker suppression.
content1: Counters flicker from artificial lighting: Auto detection, or Manual selection of 50 Hz or 60 Hz mains frequency. The Off option sends the value 0x00, which is not defined in AntiFlickerModeCU22.

tooltip: Serial Number – Reads the camera serial number.
content2: Standard camera device information. The See3CAM_CU22 SDK class has no serial number command.
getAPIDes: Not provided by the See3CAM_CU22 SDK class.

tooltip: Firmware Version – Reads the camera firmware version.
content2: Standard camera device information. The See3CAM_CU22 SDK class has no firmware version command.
getAPIDes: Not provided by the See3CAM_CU22 SDK class.

tooltip: Default – Restores camera extension controls to factory defaults.
content1: Restores all See3CAM_CU22 extension-unit controls to their factory default values.
